Our platform gives enterprises complete visibility and control over their most sensitive information, helping them prevent data breaches, achieve compliance, and confidently collaborate and innovate without compromising security.

For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves tackling data security challenges, this is the place for you!

At Seclore, we are all Entrepreneurs, not employees. Ours is a tribe of risk-takers, innovators, and fearless problem solvers. We appreciate people who are fuelled by passion, curiosity, and a hunger to learn and grow.

You'll be joining the Test/QA Automation team within Seclore's ARMOR DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) product, also referred to internally as Discovery.

The product scans and catalogs data at scale, applies sensitivity classification and labeling, and integrates with Seclore's EDRM (Enterprise Digital Rights Management) suite to trigger remediation on what it finds – so a single discovery can lead directly to a protection action, not just a report.

The platform ships on a fast, continuous release cadence (monthly feature releases), so test automation is directly on the critical path for shipping confidently and catching regressions before customers do.

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Automation Engineer with 2–4 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions for modern web and API applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong programming skills, hands-on experience with automation frameworks, and a quality-first mindset.
